answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 35178 Country: India Title: My front two teeth are very big Question: My front two teeth are very big as a girl. Many people have advised me to undergo dental treatment so that the size comes to normal. Is it permissible in Islam? Answer ID: 35178 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1708/1708/M=1432) It may not be allowable if you will not have to commit any unlawful practice. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
